reads: Each situational factor is shown with the points the engine’s own context model assigned it, so nothing here is a rule of thumb. A factor with no weight in the fit is worth nothing in this number and says so rather than being quietly rounded up.

unmeasured.item: Offensive-line, receiver, linebacker and secondary grades
unmeasured.why: EdgeDesk’s position-group player layer is college-only. There is no NFL unit grade in this repo, so the trench and coverage sections report the trench and coverage facts the NFL model does carry — sacks taken, sacks generated, EPA allowed by phase, explosive rates — and claim nothing beyond them.
the NFL rating state carries no special-teams feature at all. It is absent from the projection and from every comparison above.
